title: Opt-in sibling context for multi-bot Telegram groups

notes: Issue #44881 supplied the production failure and desired behavior.
PR #105624 supplied the first implementation and the 2026-10-06 current-main reconciliation.

problem: Mention-gated Telegram profile bots dispatch correctly but sibling agents can become context-blind.
outcomes: Sibling agents may retain bounded attributed channel context.
A later addressed sibling can use prior user and final-agent context.

invariants.text: Observation must never imply dispatch or wake an untagged bot.
Observed and mirrored rows remain context-only, never pending requests.
Sibling context remains opt-in and allowlist-scoped.
Only finalized assistant output is mirrored; drafts/interim frames are not.

decisions.text: Preserve require_mention and exclusive_bot_mentions dispatch semantics.
Mirrored context uses the sibling profile's own session namespace.

open_questions: How should duplicate wire-observed + mirrored sibling answers be deduplicated?
Should cross-host sibling context eventually use a shared transcript rather than local profile DB mirroring?
